color_evidence.basis: Estimated from the independently saved archive front image; not official HEX.

observations: Black/charcoal with a dark red linked angular arch pattern and fine vertical hatch lines; gold/white thin cuff edges and dark ring. Dark red ink traced from the full torso, with two measured clean-print repairs for the chest marks and excluded hem labels. Sleeve print extends the clean lower-front crop [255,600,340,245] at matching scale. No reflected tile seams on the torso; source lighting remains excluded. All palette values are visual estimates. Paint adapts the observed color layout to the unchanged original PNG; no second physical collar is drawn.
omitted: Emblems, logos, sponsors and lettering. Original PNG collar construction retained.
